# obsidian-mcp

> FastMCP 3.2 Obsidian vault MCP with gateway (10915), Vite dashboard (10890), LanceDB RAG, and optional Obsidian plugin bridge.

## Docs

- README.md: overview, tools, quick start
- INSTALL.md: uv/just install paths
- PRD.md: product scope and architecture
- CHANGELOG.md: release history
- AGENTS.md: agent quick reference
- mcp-server/README.md: MCPB bundle layout

## Ports

- Backend gateway: 10915 (`obsidian_mcp.gateway:app`)
- Frontend dashboard: 10890 (`web_sota/`)
- Health: GET /health

## Start

- `start.bat` or `web_sota/start.ps1` (fleet launcher)
- `just mcpb-pack` for Claude Desktop bundle

## Key paths

- MCP: src/obsidian_mcp/server.py
- Gateway: src/obsidian_mcp/gateway.py
- Webapp: web_sota/src/
- MCPB: mcp-server/manifest.json, scripts/build-mcpb.ps1
- Plugin: plugin/

## Tests

- Python: uv run pytest
- Web: cd web_sota; npm run lint; npm run test; npm run test:e2e
